function.arguments: {"finding": "The trial was not randomised, and treatment assignment was based on clinician judgement. The `arm` variable is confounded with `severity`: sicker patients (severe/moderate) are more likely to be in the treatment arm. A raw comparison of response rates between arms will be biased. We must adjust for severity (e.g., stratify or model it) before computing the treatment effect.", "implication": "We cannot compute a raw difference in proportions between treatment and control arms. We must stratify by severity and compute the treatment effect within each severity stratum, then combine them (e.g., using Mantel-Haenszel or weighted average), or model the response as a function of arm and severity. Otherwise, we risk reporting a confounded estimate with the wrong sign."}
function.name: note_finding
